_comment: Egress policy for one delegate sandbox (BUILD_B_GATEWAY.md B8). Exactly two destinations. Hosts are filled in per sandbox by agent/sandbox.py from GATEWAY_URL and CHALK_AI_GATEWAY_URL. The host list is enforced at the network layer by Daytona (domain_allow_list for names, network_allow_list for CIDRs). The per-route list is what the delegate is allowed to use on the gateway; the gateway enforces it by key class (an author key gets 403 on deploy/pause/cancel and the owner routes), not by the network. No venue address, no owner key, no general internet.

never.why: needs a bk_ key the delegate never holds

destinations.name: chalk-ai-gateway
destinations.why: the sandbox's only route to a model
